question: A sells an article to B at 20% profit. B sells it to C at 15% loss. C sells it to D at 25% profit. If the difference between the profit of A and C is ₹ 132 and B bought the article for ₹ x, then what is the value of x?
solution:
Given:

A sells an article to B at 20% profit. B sells it to C at 15% loss. C sells it to D at 25% profit.

The difference between the profit of A and C is ₹ 132

Concept used:

Selling Price = Cost Price + Cost Price × Profit%

Selling Price = Cost Price - Cost Price ×
